import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    grp_keys = ["user_id", "channel"]

    prev_ts = events.groupby(grp_keys, sort=False)["event_ts"].shift(1)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - prev_ts

    new_session = prev_ts.isna() | (gap > pd.Timedelta(minutes=25))

    session_id_within_group = new_session.groupby(
        [events["user_id"], events["channel"]]
    ).cumsum()

    events["_session_num"] = session_id_within_group

    result = events.groupby(
        ["user_id", "channel", "_session_num"], sort=False, as_index=False
    ).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "_session_num"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    result = result.rename(columns={"_session_num": "session_num"})

    result = result[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    return {"channel_sessions": result}
